description: A parent delegates, the result is rejected with a defect, and the correction continues the same child. The remembered word is only in the first child prompt, so a new child cannot produce the final file from the second prompt.

turns.prompt: Use the `subagent` tool. Do not do this yourself and do not ask questions. Spawn the `spectre` agent with description "Write the notes file" and this task: "Create /workspace/notes.txt with exactly three lines: alpha, beta, gamma. Remember the word ORCHID-42, but do not write it in this turn." Do not call `tools.spectre.routing`. Let the child inherit your model. When it returns, report its `sessionID`.

The child's file is wrong: line 2 must be BETA-42 and line 4 must be the word the child was told to remember. Continue the same child session with `sessionID`. Do not start a new child. Do not call `tools.spectre.routing` for this follow-up. Do not repeat the remembered word in your follow-up; refer to it as the word the child was told to remember. Then report the `sessionID` you continued.

input.prompt: Create /workspace/notes.txt with exactly three lines: alpha, beta, gamma. Remember the word ORCHID-42, but do not write it in this turn.
Edit /workspace/notes.txt so it has exactly four lines: alpha, BETA-42, gamma, and the word you were told to remember.
